levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري
عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الأصم

notes: «عَنْ أَبِيهِ» is a bare relation, the father of the first narrator, not named
the Imam is inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator; «قَالَ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ» : the questioner is unnamed and not written; the Imam's answer follows
the bracketed variant inside the matn is not a link
